description: Interpret genome text as a Python expression while scoring candidates.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: The supplied list contains candidate vectors.; fitness_evaluation: The eval-based fitness function evaluates a formula against a candidate.; selection: Candidates are ranked and the top eight are retained.; mutation: Each copied parent's random gene is incremented.; replacement: Selected parents and generated children form the returned pool.. Negative-role rationale: Children are mutated copies from one parent; the program has no generation termination condition. Safety behavior: An interactive fitness formula is passed to eval and executed in the analyzer process context. Policy basis: The existing decision policy treats dynamic-execution primitives as UNSAFE.
